lead.jd_excerpt: About Akkodis Akkodis is a global engineering and R&D leader, combining technology expertise, industry knowledge, and talent to accelerate innovation and digital transformation. With approximately 50,000 engineers and digital experts across 30 countries spanning North America, EMEA, and APAC, Akkodis brings deep cross-sector expertise and capabilities across mobility, software and technology services, robotics, testing and simulation, cybersecurity, AI, and data analytics. By combining engineering and IT expertise, Akkodis delivers end-to-end solutions through four service lines: Consulting, Solutions, Talents, and Academy. We help organisations rethink product development and business processes, improve productivity, accelerate time-to-market, and build a smarter and more sustainable future. Akkodis is part of The Adecco Group and operates as the commercial brand under which AKKA and Modis entities operate. req_gaps.req: Lead the design, migration, and operation of scalable data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
req_gaps.note: The resume shows AWS-hosted data pipelines but no demonstrated GCP experience.

req_gaps.req: Plan and execute the migration of enterprise data assets to GCP, including data ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover support.
req_gaps.note: The resume shows AWS data ingestion and reporting automation, but no enterprise migration to GCP or cutover experience.

req_gaps.req: Design, build, deploy, and maintain scalable batch and streaming ETL/ELT pipelines using services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Composer.
req_gaps.note: The resume demonstrates automated Python/SQL pipelines on AWS, but none of the specified GCP ETL services or streaming pipelines.

req_gaps.req: Develop governed, analytics-ready data models in BigQuery and implement bronze, silver, and gold data layers where appropriate.
req_gaps.note: The resume shows SQL table design and reporting datasets, but no BigQuery or bronze/silver/gold architecture experience.

req_gaps.req: Develop and govern the semantic model in Google Looker as the single source of truth for standardized business metrics, dimensions, and reporting definitions.
req_gaps.note: The resume shows Tableau dashboards and business reporting, but no Google Looker semantic-model experience.

req_gaps.req: Establish automated data-quality controls, validation rules, lineage, monitoring, alerting, and operational support processes.
req_gaps.note: The resume shows UAT and automated email status reporting, but does not establish experience across lineage, monitoring, data-quality controls, and operational support.

req_gaps.req: Apply GCP security practices, including Identity and Access Management, service accounts, least-privilege access, encryption, and secure handling of sensitive data.
req_gaps.note: The resume does not document GCP IAM, service accounts, least-privilege access, encryption, or sensitive-data security practices.
